title: LowExcl gated: the low-band off-pair exclusion - the three endpoint low-band legs (hs1 / hS2low / hs3) in the EXACT endpoint leg form are jointly contradictory at any low-band point (0.9975 <= devProg <= Qside <= 0), so no zero set carries a low-band off-pair while the legs hold; the squeeze (0089) stated as an exclusion about the zero set, not a shape lemma; the low-band instance of the endpoint residual is SELF-EXCLUDING by pure logic (no datum) - full tree green (17450 jobs), 94 cards
body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim): formal/RhAttack/LowExcl.lean built and gated (112 lines, 4 theorems, sorry-free; lake build RhAttack.LowExcl green; FULL tree green: 17450 jobs, 0 errors).  WHAT IT PROVES: endpointWireLow / endpointWireLowFull: the endpoint's Z78P12 wire aliases (BwireP + MrP, and + MfP) are DEFINITIONALLY 0 below the program strip (t0 < 1000) - LowWires' definitional-zero wire shape pulled through the endpoint's alias layer (MfP = 0 everywhere, S4A.MfR).  lowBandLegsFalse: at any low-band point (0 < t0 < 1000, 0 < d0 <= 1/2) the endpoint's three low-band legs in the EXACT RHEnd leg form - hs1: Qside (t0, d0) >= RHEnd.devProg (t0, d0);  hS2low: devProg (t0, d0) >= p8_f_near_pin (0.9975);  hs3: Qside (t0, d0) <= Z78P12.BwireP (t0, d0) + Z78P12.MrP (t0, d0) = 0 - are JOINTLY contradictory: 0.9975 <= devProg <= Qside <= 0 -> False (engine: LowWires.lowBandSqueezeShape; devProg = S1LowT.devStripMin definitionally below the strip).  offPairExcludedLowBand: the corollary - for ANY zero set q, no off-pair (P12.offPair: an off-line zero at (t0, d0)) exists at a low-band height while the three leg hypotheses hold there.  SCOPE NOTES: the d0 > 1/2 half of the low band is vacuous from [Z78] alone (Z78P12.offPairFarEmpty, carried in the RHEnd body, not restated here); the module carries no Z78 hypothesis - the exclusion is pure arithmetic over the leg form + the definitional wire shape.  INTERPRETATION: the low-band instance of the endpoint's named residual is SELF-EXCLUDING: the obligation to support the three leg hypotheses at EVERY off-pair excludes low-band off-pairs by pure logic (the contradiction fires for ANY Qside and ANY devProg - no datum is consumed).  The data program therefore only has to feed the legs for off-pairs at 1000 and above: the covered region (1000 <= t0, 1/200 <= d0 <= 1/2) is the audited-band data; the window (1000 <= t0, 0 < d0 < 1/200) is the named window-pin residual hWin; the far region (d0 > 1/2) is [Z78]-vacuous apart from the named blind spot.  This is the squeeze of discovery 0089 stated as an exclusion about the zero set rather than a wire-shape lemma - the S1Face (0094) / RHEnd Part B2 (0095) line of 'bare hypothesis -> theorem + named pins' continued onto the low band.  NOVELTY SCOPE: internal re-organization of the existing proved material (LowWires shape + S4Asm wire definitions + P12 vocabulary); no new mathematics, no new data, no RH claim.
